title: Lavished Grace
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: God's grace isn't doled out in tiny drops. He spared no expense and pulled out all the stops for you. It is an ocean.
exhortation: Something captures our hearts when people go really big. Have you noticed that? When you see someone spare no expense, it makes your jaw drop. Someone poured an incredible amount of time, money and effort into this. They spared nothing.

What has God spared nothing on this morning? What has he pulled out all the stops for? For you. "In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses." This is the first great extravagance, the most precious thing God could give, and he gave it. He offered his only Son so that we might be redeemed.

And how was it done? "According to the riches of his grace, which he lavished upon us." God's grace isn't sprinkled on you in tiny drops or doled out in miserly little portions. It is a wealth of grace. To lavish is to give generously, extravagantly, in huge quantities. That is exactly how we should feel today about God's grace toward us. It is like an ocean.
This truth is worth remembering, recounting and shouting until our souls are filled with gratitude. Lord, help us stop, remember and revel in your lavish and wondrous grace.
prayer: Lord, this is just the beginning. We haven't even begun to taste how great your love is and how wonderful the joys you have in store for us. Thank you for saving us. What extravagant grace, and what mercy whose depths we can't find. We will think, sing and talk about it for all eternity and never reach the end. What an amazing thing, that you would come and save sinners like us. We are so grateful.

Go with each person today as they do the tasks before them. Strengthen our hands and feet, and be with us in our minds, thoughts and hearts, so that we walk in a way that glorifies you today. We pray this in Jesus' name. Amen.
